parsed.explanation: The dossier is thin on traveller-facing evidence. The 2022 court ruling removed the sodomy and indecency offences, and no trans-specific criminal offence is documented, so there is no known criminalisation lever. Against that, the government resisted repeal for years, no statutory anti-discrimination protection exists, and the court's reading of sex discrimination has not been shown to operate in any later case. Social acceptance is not documented. The only violence evidence is one dated assault on an activist, which cannot establish a rate. Border, document-screening, custody and police practice toward visitors are unsourced, so they are open questions rather than exposures. Same-sex union non-recognition is a tangential general-LGB signal. Extrapolating from a state that decriminalised by court order but offers no protective machinery and shows no recorded acceptance places it in the elevated band, toward its upper edge.
